北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京晴好，体感舒适，户外活动别忘补水哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny and pleasant. Don't forget to hydrate during outdoor activities!

宁波.name: 宁波
宁波.ai_briefing_zh: 宁波多云，湿度 93%，体感 28℃。天气闷热，多喝水。
宁波.ai_briefing_en: Ningbo is cloudy, 93% humidity, feels like 28℃. It's muggy, drink plenty of water.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海晴好，体感 30℃，紫外线强，注意防晒！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is sunny and feels like 30℃. UV is strong, remember sun protection!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州小雨，路面湿滑。出门带伞，注意交通安全。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou has light rain, roads are slippery. Take an umbrella and mind traffic safety.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天，体感 30℃，天气闷热，多喝水哦。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy and feels like 30℃. It's muggy, drink plenty of water!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州有雾，能见度低，驾车出行请减速慢行。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is foggy, visibility is low. Please drive slowly and carefully.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴热，湿度 98%，体感 30℃。注意防暑，多补水。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is sunny and hot, 98% humidity, feels like 30℃. Stay cool and hydrated.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都大雨，体感偏凉。出门带伞，添衣保暖哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu has heavy rain and feels cool. Bring an umbrella and dress warmly!
成都.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉多云，湿度 100%，体感 30℃，闷热，注意防暑。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy with 100% humidity, feels like 30℃. It's muggy, mind heatstroke.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，体感 28℃。天气多变，备件薄外套哦。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy and feels like 28℃. Weather changes, keep a light jacket handy.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感 32℃。天气炎热，注意防暑降温！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy and feels like 32℃. It's hot, stay cool and prevent heatstroke!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨多云，湿度高。体感舒适，户外别忘补水。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is cloudy with high humidity. Feels comfortable, stay hydrated outdoors.

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳阴天，湿度 100%，体感舒适。注意保持好心情。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy with 100% humidity. Feels pleasant, keep a good mood!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，体感 16℃，微凉。早晚温差大，注意添衣。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy and feels like 16℃, a bit cool. Mind temperature changes and dress accordingly.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云，体感 29℃。天气闷热，注意及时补水。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy and feels like 29℃. It's muggy, remember to hydrate in time.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛有雾，能见度低。驾车出行请务必减速慢行。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is foggy, visibility is low. Please drive slowly and carefully.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连有雾，能见度低。注意交通安全，出行慢行。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is foggy, visibility is low. Mind traffic safety, travel slowly.

漳浦.name: 漳浦
漳浦.ai_briefing_zh: 漳浦有雾，能见度低。出行请注意安全，减速慢行。
漳浦.ai_briefing_en: Zhangpu is foggy, visibility is low. Travel safely, drive slowly.

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪晴热，体感 30℃，记得防晒，多喝水！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is hot and sunny, feels like 30℃. Remember sunscreen and drink plenty of water!
